data.name: Mubashirun
data.gender_notes: Mubashirun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who announces or conveys good news, a prophet or messenger. The name Mubashirun carries the meaning “Bringer of Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mubashirun usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the blessings and guidance that come from Allah, and the role of the bearer in spreading positivity and good tidings to others
data.etymology: Mubashirun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubashirun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مبشرون
in_arabic.meaning: المبشرون هم الذين يبشرون الناس بالخير وينشرون الفرح
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبشرون هو اسم جمع مشتق من الفعل بشر، ويعني الذين يبشرون الناس بالخير وينشرون الفرح والسرور في قلوبهم. ورد هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة التوبة الآية 23 {إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَنْ يُشْرَكَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَلِكَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدِ افْتَرَى إِثْمًا مُبِينًا} في سياق الحديث عن المشركين، وقد وردت مشتقاته في عدة آيات قرآنية، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة دينية وروحانية كبيرة.

in_urdu.name: مبشرون
in_urdu.meaning: مبشرون وہ لوگ ہیں جو اچھی خبر دیتے ہیں اور فرح پھیلاتے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبشرون کا نام جمع ہے جو فارسی زبان کے 'بشر' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشخبری دینا یا اچھی خبر پھیلانا۔ اس نام کا تعلق اسلامی ثقافت سے ہے جہاں مبشرون ان فرشتوں یا انسانوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اچھی خبر یا بشارت دیتے ہیں۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام انبیاء اور رسولوں کے ساتھ بھی منسلک ہے جنہوں نے اپنی قوم کو اچھی خبر دی۔ روحانی طور پر، یہ نام امید، فرح اور اچھی خبر کے پھیلاؤ کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुबाशिरुन
in_hindi.meaning: मुबाशिरुन वे लोग हैं जो अच्छी खबर देते हैं और खुशी फैलाते हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबाशिरुन नाम की उत्पत्ति संस्कृत और अरबी भाषाओं में हुई है, जहां 'बशर' का अर्थ है 'आनंद' या 'खुशी'। यह नाम उन लोगों को संदर्भित करता है जो अच्छी खबर देते हैं और दूसरों के जीवन में खुशी और सकारात्मकता लाते हैं। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो दूसरों को प्रेरित करते हैं और उन्हें सही रास्ते पर चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: مبشرون
in_pashto.meaning: مبشرون هغه کسان دي چې ښې خبرې ورکوي او خوښۍ خپروي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبشرون د جمع کلمه ده چې د 'بشر' څخه اخیستل شوې ده، چې معنی یې د ښې خبرې ورکول یا خوښۍ خپرول دي. په افغانستان کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې ښې خبرې او پیغامونه راوړي. دا نوم د امید، خوښۍ او مثبت احساساتو د خپرولو نښه ده.

in_english.name: Mubashirun
in_english.meaning: Mubashirun means those who give good news or bring glad tidings
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mubashirun originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the verb 'bashara,' which means 'to give good news' or 'to bring glad tidings.' In Islamic tradition, Mubashirun refers to those who bring positive messages, hope, and joy to others. This name is associated with prophets and messengers who brought good news to their communities. Spiritually, Mubashirun symbolizes hope, positivity, and the spreading of joy and good tidings.

data.cultural_impact: Mubashirun is an Arabic name that holds great significance in Islamic culture, especially within the context of prophets and messengers. The term "Mubashirun" refers to those individuals who were chosen by Allah to convey good news or blessings to people. Prophet Muhammad SAWS (Peace be upon Him) is an excellent example of a Mubashirun, as he was sent as the final messenger to guide humanity towards the right path. This name holds an important place in Islamic traditions and histories, as it symbolizes the role of prophets and messengers as bearers of good news and bringers of blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mubashirun holds profound significance as it reflects the essence of Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creation. Allah, in His infinite wisdom and love, chooses certain individuals as His channels of communication to convey His messages and guidance to humanity. Mubashirun, thus, serves as a powerful reminder of the importance of Prophets and Messengers in guiding humanity towards the right path. Moreover, it underscores the spiritual privilege and responsibility that comes with being a messenger or conduit of Allah's words and blessings.
